ACT II OF 1995
ACT II OF 1995
NORTH WEST
FRONTIER PROVINCE SALARIES, ALLOWANCES AND PRIVILEGES OF PUBLIC REPRESENTATIVES
(AMENDMENT) ACT, 1995
An Act Further to
amend the laws relating to the Salaries, allowances and privileges of
Ministers, Speaker, Deputy Speaker and Members of the Provincial Assembly
[Gazette of N.‑W.F.P.,
Extraordinary, 12th July, 1995]
No. PA/N.‑W.F.P./Legis/95/13383,
dated 12‑7‑1995.‑‑The North -West Frontier Province
Salaries, Allowances and Privileges of Public representatives (Amendment) Bill,
1995, having been passed by the Provincial Assembly of the North‑West
Frontier Province on the 4th July 1995 and assented to by the Governor of the
North‑West Frontier Province on the 10th July, 1995 is hereby published
as an Act of the Provincial Legislature of North -West Frontier
1. Short title and
commencement.‑‑(1) This Act may be called the North‑West
Frontier Province Salaries, Allowances and Privileges of Public Representatives
Laws (Amendment) Act, 1995.
(2) It shall come into force at
once, and shall always be deemed to have come into force with effect from First
of July, 1995.
